strict_host_key_checking.description: How to handle unknown or changed host keys. Use 'auto' (accept new), 'yes' (strict), or 'no' (disable).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, etc.

forward_agent.description: Enable SSH agent forwarding globally (pass local agent to remote hosts).

forward_x11.description: Enable X11 forwarding (required for GUI apps over SSH).

connect_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for connection establishment.

password_authentication.description: Allow password-based authentication (recommended: false for security).

preferred_authentications.description: Ordered list of authentication methods to try (publickey first for key-based auth).

server_alive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive messages to detect dead connections.

server_alive_count_max.description: Number of unanswered keepalives before disconnecting.

compression.description: Enable compression of SSH traffic (useful for slow connections).

protocol.description: SSH protocol version to use (only 2 is modern and secure).

tcp_keepalive.description: Send TCP-level keepalive messages (helps detect broken firewalls/NATs).

host_configs.description: List of additional per-host or pattern-specific configurations. Each item defines settings for specific hosts.

pattern.description: Hostname pattern (e.g., '*.example.com', 'prod-*', or exact host like 'server1').

comment.description: Optional human-readable description for the entry (shown in comments).

strict_host_key_checking.description: Override global StrictHostKeyChecking for this host (auto/yes/no).

identity_file.description: List of private key paths to try for authentication.

forward_agent.description: Override global ForwardAgent for this host.

forward_x11.description: Override global ForwardX11 for this host.

proxy_jump.description: List of jump hosts (e.g., ['jump.example.com', 'proxy2']) to traverse before reaching target host.
